# Home

URL: https://cloudofworship.com/

Run your church media smoothly, without the heavy setup. Cloud of Worship is a free browser-based presentation software to display song lyrics, scriptures, videos and fully customizable slides for your growing church.

# Pricing

URL: https://cloudofworship.com/pricing

Cloud of Worship is free to use. A Starter plan is available at no cost; a Teams plan is available for $24.99/month or $249.99/year for advanced collaboration features.

Pricing Cloud of Worship is free Yes, without watermarks! We believe every congregation deserves access to quality and affordable tools to enhance their worship experience.

# Help Center: Getting Started

URL: https://cloudofworship.com/docs/getting-started

Create your account, understand the two-window setup and put your first slide on screen in five minutes.

New to Cloud of Worship? Start here. These guides take you from signing up to a Bible verse on your church projector: creating your church account or joining one through an invite, signing in, the guided tour, and the two windows you work with. The Control Center is where you prepare and run the service, and the Live Display is what your congregation sees.

Most churches are presenting within five minutes. If you only read one page, read [Your first five minutes](/docs/getting-started/your-first-five-minutes).

---

## Help Center: What is Cloud of Worship?

URL: https://cloudofworship.com/docs/getting-started/what-is-cloud-of-worship

Presentation software for churches that runs in your browser, with a Control Center for you and a Live Display for your congregation.

Cloud of Worship (CoW) is presentation software for churches. You build a slide schedule for a service (songs, scripture, hymns, sermon notes, media) in one window, and project it full-screen on a second display for your congregation.

## Two windows, one service

The app runs in **two windows at once**:

| Window | URL | Who sees it |
|--------|-----|-------------|
| **Control Center** | `app.cloudofworship.com` | You, the operator |
| **Live Display** | `app.cloudofworship.com/live` | Your congregation (projector or second screen) |

Everything you do happens in the Control Center. Nothing reaches the Live Display until you explicitly promote it.

::callout{type="important" title="Same browser, both windows"}
The Control Center and Live Display talk to each other through the browser itself. Open both in the **same browser**. Running the Control Center in Chrome and the live window in Safari will not work.
::

## No install required

Cloud of Worship runs entirely in your browser.

- **URL:** `app.cloudofworship.com`
- **Browsers:** Chrome, Firefox, Safari and Edge. Chrome or Edge are recommended if you want automatic multi-screen detection.
- **Installable:** you can install CoW to your dock or taskbar as an app. See [Installing Cloud of Worship](/docs/settings-and-shortcuts/installing-cloud-of-worship).
- **Native desktop app:** on Windows there is also a native desktop app, which adds real multi-monitor windows, [NDI output](/docs/going-live/ndi-output) and background updates. [Download it here](/download), or read [the desktop app guide](/docs/settings-and-shortcuts/desktop-app).
- **On a phone:** on a Teams plan, a phone is a full operator. You can build slides and drive the projector at the media desk from it. See [using CoW on your phone](/docs/teams-and-collaboration/using-cloud-of-worship-on-your-phone).

You'll normally run it on a laptop connected to a projector or second monitor.

## Logging in

![Login screen](/images/docs/00-login.webp)

Already have an account? Sign in with **Google** or with your **email and password**. New here? Click **Create an account** and follow the [sign-up wizard](/docs/getting-started/creating-your-account).

## Where to go next

- [Your first five minutes](/docs/getting-started/your-first-five-minutes) walks you from login to a slide on screen.
- [The Control Center layout](/docs/control-center/layout-overview) explains the three panes you'll work in.
- [Going live](/docs/going-live/opening-the-live-display) covers the projector setup.

---

## Help Center: Creating Your Account

URL: https://cloudofworship.com/docs/getting-started/creating-your-account

Sign up with Google or email in a short guided wizard: your name, your church, optional team invites, verification and plan choice.

Signing up is a **5-step guided wizard**, not one long form. Your progress is shown as five dashes at the bottom of the screen from Step 2 onward.

## Step 1: Get started (credentials)

![Get Started, sign-up step 1](/images/docs/16-signup-step1.webp)

Choose one:

- **Sign up with Google**: one click. Google accounts arrive **pre-verified**, so you skip email verification entirely.
- **Email and password**: enter your email and choose a password.

**Password rules:** at least **8 characters**, including **a letter, a number and a symbol**. If it doesn't match you'll see *"Password must include a letter, a number and a symbol"*. **Continue** stays disabled until both fields are valid.

::callout{type="important" title="This step creates your account immediately"}
There's no final "submit everything" at the end of the wizard. Double-check your email before continuing. If it's already registered you'll see *"Email linked to an account"*. Use **Sign in** instead.
::

## Step 2: What should we call you?

Enter your **Full name**. Teammates see this in the Invite list, in presence indicators, and on slides you have locked for editing.

Signed up with Google? This is **pre-filled** from your Google display name. Just hit Continue.

## Step 3: Tell us about your church

| Field | Notes |
|-------|-------|
| **Are you creating this account for a church?** | Toggle. Switch it **off** for a non-church organization, and every label on the step changes from "church" to "organization". |
| **Church name** | Searchable dropdown of known churches. |
| **Enter church name** | Appears only if you pick **"Other Church (not included)"** or turn the toggle off. Free text. |
| **Church type** | Dropdown (see below). |
| **Head of ministry** | Your pastor or ministry lead. |

**Church type options:** Headquarters · Provincial Headquarters · Zonal Parish · Area / District Parish · Branch · Campus Parish · Online Campus · House Fellowship / Center

All three of church name, type and head of ministry are required before **Continue** activates.

::callout{type="tip" title="Don't create a duplicate church"}
If a teammate already created your church in CoW, **search for it rather than creating a duplicate**. Joining the existing church shares schedules, songs and library items with your team from day one.
::

If you're already signed in but have no church, CoW routes you straight to this step.

## Step 4: Will anyone be joining now? (optional)

Type a teammate's email and click **Add** (or press **Enter**). Each becomes a removable chip. Add as many as you like, then **Continue** to send all invitations at once.

Not ready? Click **"I'll do this later"**.

## Step 5: How can we reach you? (optional)

| Field | Notes |
|-------|-------|
| **Your phone number** | Phone input with country picker. Required for the primary **Continue** button. |
| **How did you find us?** | Optional: Google Search · Social Media · Word of Mouth / Friend · YouTube · Church Community / WhatsApp Group · App Store · Other |

Both are skippable. **"I'll do this later"** finishes onboarding immediately.

## Step 6: Verify your account

Email and password sign-ups get a verification code by email. Google sign-ups skip this entirely.

1. **Enter the code**: 6 characters, auto-uppercased as you type.
2. **Didn't get it?** Click **Resend code**. There's a **120-second cooldown** (counted down inside the input) and a maximum of **3 resends**.
3. **Wrong email?** Click your email address in the subtitle to make it editable, fix it, and click **Save email**. CoW updates your account and sends a fresh code automatically.

::callout{type="tip"}
A code is sent automatically the moment you land here. Check your inbox and spam before hitting Resend.
::

## Step 7: Choose a plan

After verification, CoW shows the **plan chooser** (Free or Teams). Dismiss it and decide later if you prefer. You can change plans anytime in **App Settings → Subscription Settings**. See [Plans: Free vs Teams](/docs/teams-and-collaboration/plans-free-vs-teams).

## The full flow at a glance

```
Step 1            Step 2       Step 3          Step 4         Step 5        Step 6      Step 7
Credentials  →    Your name →  Your church  →  Invite team →  Contact   →   Verify  →   Pick a
(Google/email)                                 (skippable)    (skippable)   email       plan
     │                                                                        │
     └── Google sign-up ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
         (pre-verified, skips Step 6)
```

You land in the Control Center with an empty account. The Slide Schedule reads **"No slides yet"** until you create your first schedule. Next: [the guided tour](/docs/getting-started/the-guided-tour), then [Schedules](/docs/building-your-service/schedules).

---

## Help Center: Joining an Existing Church

URL: https://cloudofworship.com/docs/getting-started/joining-an-existing-church

Invited by a teammate? Your invite link opens a short join page instead of the full sign-up wizard.

If a teammate invites you, your invite link opens a **dedicated join page** rather than the normal 5-step wizard. It shows:

- **"Join [Church name], [Church type] on Cloud of Worship"**
- The avatars of people already in the workspace, and a line like *"Favour Felix and others already joined"*

## Creating your account from an invite

You fill in a single short form (**Full name**, **Email address**, **Choose a password**) and click **Create your account**.

Because the church already exists, you skip the church-creation and team-invite steps entirely and land straight in the shared workspace.

::callout{type="tip"}
On this page the password hint is the simpler *"at least 8 characters and include a letter and a number."*
::

## Getting an invite

Ask an existing member to click **Invite** in the Control Center's top bar. They can email you directly or copy an invite link. See [Working as a Team](/docs/teams-and-collaboration/working-as-a-team).

---

## Help Center: Signing In & Password Recovery

URL: https://cloudofworship.com/docs/getting-started/signing-in-and-password-recovery

Sign in with Google or email, reset a forgotten password, and sign out.

## Signing in

Go to `app.cloudofworship.com/login` and use **Google** or your **email and password**.

## Forgot your password

1. Click **Forgot password** on the login screen.
2. On the **"Forgot password?"** page, enter the email linked to your account. *"A reset link will be sent to this address."*
3. Click **Continue** and check your inbox.

## Resetting it

The emailed link opens the **"Reset password"** page. Enter your **New password** and **Confirm password**, then submit.

- Password must be **at least 8 characters and include a letter and a number**.
- If the link is incomplete or expired you'll see *"This password reset link is missing required information"* with a **Request new link** button.

## Signing out

Use the **Sign out** item in the avatar menu, or the **Sign Out** quick action. You'll briefly see a *"Signing out"* screen while your session ends.

::callout{type="tip" title="Having trouble?"}
See [Account & sign-in problems](/docs/troubleshooting/account-and-sign-in-problems) for the most common fixes.
::

---

## Help Center: Your First Five Minutes

URL: https://cloudofworship.com/docs/getting-started/your-first-five-minutes

From login to a Bible verse on your projector in five short steps.

Here's the fastest path from a fresh account to a slide on screen.

## 1. Log in

Log in at `app.cloudofworship.com`. You land in the **Control Center**.

## 2. Create a schedule

Click the **⌄** next to the schedule name in the top bar. Pick a template (**Regular Sunday**, **Communion Service**, **Christmas Schedule**) or **Start from blank**.

![Create a schedule dialog](/images/docs/01-schedule-picker.webp)

## 3. Add your first slide

From the **Quick Actions Pane** on the left, click **Display Bible** and search `John 3:16`. Select the verse and it lands in your schedule.

![Display Bible panel](/images/docs/04-display-bible.webp)

## 4. Open the live window

Click **Go Live → Open live window** in the Slide Schedule Pane header, and drag that window to your projector. Double-click it (or press **F**) to go fullscreen.

## 5. Promote the slide

Click the slide in the **Slide Schedule Pane** to promote it to the Live Display. The projected slide gets a red **LIVE** badge.

![A slide live with the LIVE badge](/images/docs/13-go-live-active.webp)

::callout{type="success" title="That's it"}
You're projecting. Press **↓** and **↑** to move through the schedule, and **B** to blank the screen.
::

## Keep going

- [The Control Center layout](/docs/control-center/layout-overview)
- [Adding songs and hymns](/docs/building-your-service/adding-songs-and-hymns)
- [Multi-screen setup](/docs/going-live/multi-screen-setup)
- [Keyboard shortcuts](/docs/settings-and-shortcuts/keyboard-shortcuts)

## Help Center: The Guided Tour

URL: https://cloudofworship.com/docs/getting-started/the-guided-tour

A two-minute, nine-step spotlight tour that appears the first time you reach the Control Center with a slide on your schedule.

The first time you reach the Control Center with a slide on your schedule, CoW opens a welcome card:

> **"Welcome to Cloud of Worship. Let's make you a pro in no time"**
> *"A quick, 2-minute tour of everything you need to prepare, manage, and run your service: from lyrics and scripture to the live screen. Don't skip"*

Click **"Show me around"** to start it, or dismiss it. It doesn't reappear on its own once dismissed.

## The nine steps

1. **Quick Search Bar**: search actions, songs, scriptures, or anything else.
2. **Quick Actions**: every way to build a slide.
3. **Preview and Edit Content**: where new slides land.
4. **Slide Schedule**: your running order. Drag to reorder, click to take live.
5. **Live Preview**: exactly what your congregation would see.
6. **Go Live**: open the live window or stage display, or copy a livestream or stage display link.
7. **Open a Bible slide**: interactive. The tour pauses here and asks you to actually select or create a Bible slide (try typing a reference like `John 3 16` in the search bar) before continuing.
8. **Verse Switcher**: type a reference and press Enter. Shorthand works (for example `mat 28 19` → Matthew 28:19).
9. **Text Formatting**: the toolbar for sizing and styling text.

::callout{type="tip" title="Step 7 waits for you"}
The **Next** button won't advance until a Bible slide is actually selected. This is the one step of the tour that needs you to act, not just read.
::

- [Layout overview](/docs/control-center/layout-overview): the three panes the tour points at.
- [Your first five minutes](/docs/getting-started/your-first-five-minutes): put a Bible verse on your projector.
- [Keyboard shortcuts](/docs/settings-and-shortcuts/keyboard-shortcuts): the shortcut sheet the tour mentions.

# Help Center: The Control Center

URL: https://cloudofworship.com/docs/control-center

A tour of the three panes you work in, the top bar, the live preview and the searchable Quick Actions.

The Control Center is the screen you work in during the week and on Sunday. It has three panes: **Quick Actions** on the left for creating slides and searching everything, **Preview and Edit Content** in the middle for editing the selected slide, and the **Slide Schedule** for your running order. Above them sit the top bar and a live preview of what's on the projector.

These guides walk through each pane, and the [Quick Actions reference](/docs/control-center/quick-actions-reference) lists every action and the plan it needs.

---

## Help Center: Layout Overview

URL: https://cloudofworship.com/docs/control-center/layout-overview

The Control Center is divided into three panes: Quick Actions, Preview and Edit Content, and the Slide Schedule.

The Cloud of Worship interface is divided into three main sections:

1. **Quick Actions Pane** (left)
2. **Preview and Edit Content Pane** (centre)
3. **Slide Schedule Pane** (bottom right)

Each section is designed to simplify controlling your church's on-screen projection and let you multitask effectively.

![The three-pane Control Center](/images/docs/02-operator-dashboard.webp)

## Resizing the panes

The left and right panes are **resizable**. Drag the divider between panes and CoW remembers your widths between sessions (within built-in min and max limits). The Preview and Edit Content pane can also be resized vertically between its grid and editor halves.

## The panes in detail

| Pane | What it's for | Read more |
|------|---------------|-----------|
| **Quick Actions** | Every tool and action, searchable | [Quick Actions Pane](/docs/control-center/quick-actions-pane) |
| **Preview and Edit Content** | Modify, edit and format slides before they go live | [Preview and Edit Pane](/docs/control-center/preview-and-edit-pane) |
| **Slide Schedule** | Your running order. Click a slide to take it live | [Slide Schedule Pane](/docs/control-center/slide-schedule-pane) |
| **Top bar and Live Output Preview** | Schedule switching, invites, theme, account, and a mirror of the live screen | [Top Bar & Live Preview](/docs/control-center/top-bar-and-live-preview) |

::callout{type="important"}
Slides appear in the Slide Schedule as soon as they're added, but they **will not go live until you explicitly promote them** to the Live Display.
::

---

## Help Center: The Quick Actions Pane

URL: https://cloudofworship.com/docs/control-center/quick-actions-pane

Every tool in CoW, presented in an easy-to-search format. One search box covers actions, the Bible, your songs, your library and the hymnal.

*Left pane.*

The Quick Actions Pane is where you'll find all the tools and actions you can perform in Cloud of Worship, presented in an easy-to-search format. Sometimes you want to accomplish a task but can't remember the exact steps. The Quick Actions Pane makes everything searchable, so you don't have to memorise the process.

## Default and searchable actions

- **Default actions:** the most commonly used actions are shown by default: Display Bible, Search Whole Bible, Display Hymns, Transcribe Sermon, Add Song, My Library, Search song lyrics, Song Setlist, Create Text Slide, Add Media and Slide Templates.
- **Searchable actions:** *everything* is indexed, including actions not in the default list: "Go to app settings", "Take screen live", "Force sync" / **Refresh Slides**, "Create new schedule", "Sign out", "Upgrade Plan", "What's New", **Join Community**, and every individual settings page.

The full list is in the [Quick Actions reference](/docs/control-center/quick-actions-reference).

## The search box searches everything

Type into the search box and CoW searches your **actions, the Bible, your songs, your library and the hymnal simultaneously**.

![Quick Actions search returning actions, scripture, songs and hymns together](/images/docs/05-display-hymns.webp)

It understands what you type:

- **Bible references** such as *John 3:16* or *1 Cor 13*, including common book abbreviations, go straight to scripture.
- **Hymns** match by title or number. If you don't see yours, the **Can't find the hymn?** row opens the hymn panel with your search already typed in.
- **Songs** match by title or by a lyric line, and the matching line is highlighted.
- Each group has a **See all** row that jumps into that panel with your search carried over.

Results are grouped under filter chips (**Bible · Song lyrics · Hymns · Library · Actions · More**) so you can narrow a busy result set.

::callout{type="tip" title="Jump to search from anywhere"}
Press **`/`** anywhere in the app to jump straight into the Quick Actions search. **Cmd/Ctrl + K** works too.
::

::callout{type="tip"}
The placeholder rotates through real examples (*"Matt 28:19"*, *"Amazing Grace"*, *"Way Maker"*, *"kids pickup alert"*, *"30s timer"*, *"motion background"*), a good hint at the range of things you can type.
::

## New actions

A newly released action carries a **NEW** badge for its first 60 days. The first time you open it, a short animation shows how it works. Interlude and Add Camera have these now, and Import Slides (PDF) and Transcribe Sermon show the same kind of intro in their panels.

## Navigating inside an action

Choosing an action switches the pane into that action's own view with a breadcrumb at the top, for example **Quick Actions › Bible**. Click **Quick Actions** in the breadcrumb, or the **✕**, to go back.

---

## Help Center: The Preview and Edit Content Pane

URL: https://cloudofworship.com/docs/control-center/preview-and-edit-pane

The processing and refinement centre: a grid of every slide in the schedule and an editor for the one you've selected.

*Centre pane.*

The Preview and Edit Content Pane is what we like to call the **"processing and refinement centre"**. This is where you modify, edit and format slides before promoting them to the live display.

## Two halves

| Half | What it shows |
|------|---------------|
| **Top: the slide grid** | Every slide in the active schedule as a thumbnail, tagged with its type (Text, Media, Song, Hymn, Setlist…). Click one to select it. |
| **Bottom: the editor** | The selected slide's editor. Until you select something it reads *"Select slide above to start editing"*. |

Slides in this pane are highly flexible. You can make changes **even while they are being displayed live**, applying unique modifications to individual slides in real time without disrupting your presentation. See [Editing a slide](/docs/building-your-service/editing-a-slide).

::callout{type="important"}
Slides appear in the Slide Schedule as soon as they are added to this pane, but they **will not go live until you explicitly promote them** to the Live Display.
::

## The slide card menu (⋮)

Hover a thumbnail and click **⋮**:

| Menu item | What it does |
|-----------|--------------|
| **Duplicate Slide** | Copy it within the same schedule |
| **Duplicate as Overlay** | Copy it as an overlay layer that shows *on top of* the live slide instead of replacing it |
| **Save to Library** | Save to My Library for reuse in any future schedule |
| **Save as Template** | Save its styling as a reusable template |
| **Delete Slide** | Remove it. Asks to confirm, and is not reversible |

## Select Slides (bulk mode)

Click **Select Slides** in the pane header to act on many slides at once. You can select all, or clear the selection and exit bulk mode.

---

## Help Center: The Slide Schedule Pane

URL: https://cloudofworship.com/docs/control-center/slide-schedule-pane

Your running order. Every slide that's ready to go live, and the Blank and Go Live controls.

*Bottom-right pane.*

The Slide Schedule Pane shows all the slides that are ready to be promoted to the live display. Each slide is presented with:

- a **small preview** of the slide,
- a **unique slide name**,
- a **slide type** badge (Text, Media, Song, Hymn, Setlist, Bible…).

## Promoting a slide

**To promote a slide to the live display, simply click on it.** The projected slide is marked with a red **LIVE** badge.

![A slide live with the LIVE badge](/images/docs/13-go-live-active.webp)

## Row actions

Hovering a row reveals two icons on the right:

| Icon | Action |
|------|--------|
| ✏️ **Pencil** | *Preview / Edit Slide*: opens it in the Preview and Edit Content Pane |
| 🗑️ **Trash** | *Delete slide*: confirms first |

## Live controls

The pane header holds the two live controls: **Blank** and **Go Live**. See [Opening the Live Display](/docs/going-live/opening-the-live-display) and [Blank screen](/docs/going-live/blank-screen).

::callout{type="tip"}
**Drag a song slide onto a Song Setlist slide** in this pane to add it to that setlist. See [Song Setlists](/docs/building-your-service/song-setlists).
::

---

## Help Center: The Top Bar & Live Output Preview

URL: https://cloudofworship.com/docs/control-center/top-bar-and-live-preview

Rename and switch schedules, invite teammates, toggle the theme, open your account menu, and watch a mirror of the live screen.

## The top bar

| Element | What it does |
|---------|--------------|
| **Schedule name** (centre) | Click to rename the current schedule inline |
| **Chevron ⌄** | Opens the schedule switcher and the **Create a schedule** dialog |
| **Invite** | Opens the invite modal for your church workspace |
| **Theme toggle** | Light / dark mode |
| **Teams badge** | Click it for a random tip about using Cloud of Worship |
| **Avatar** (far right) | Your account menu: church name, **App Settings**, **Shortcut & Hotkeys**, **Sign out** |

## The Live Output Preview

*Top-right pane.* A miniature mirror of exactly what your congregation sees right now, with the slide title and a **LIVE** badge. The badge stays grey and still until the output actually reaches a screen: a live window, the Stage Display or a livestream page is open. It turns red once something is on air. When nothing is live it shows the blank or idle screen.

Use the expand icon in its bottom-right corner to enlarge it.

## Related guides

- [Schedules](/docs/building-your-service/schedules): create, switch, rename and delete schedules.
- [Working as a team](/docs/teams-and-collaboration/working-as-a-team): what happens after you invite a teammate.
- [Opening the live display](/docs/going-live/opening-the-live-display): get the output onto your projector.
- [Settings reference](/docs/settings-and-shortcuts/settings-reference): every page in App Settings.

Every action available in the Quick Actions Pane, grouped by what it does, with the plan it needs.

Many of them open on the Free plan so you can try them, and ask you to upgrade only when you create the slide. # Help Center: Building Your Service

URL: https://cloudofworship.com/docs/building-your-service

Schedules, slide types, scripture, songs, hymns, text, media, backgrounds, your library and song setlists.

Everything you need to put a church service together before Sunday: schedules for each service, Bible verses, song lyrics and hymns, announcement text slides, images and videos, countdown timers, camera feeds and PDF decks. You'll also find how to style a slide, add backgrounds, keep songs in your library and run a worship medley from a single setlist.

New to it? Start with [Schedules](/docs/building-your-service/schedules), then [Slide types](/docs/building-your-service/slide-types) to see what each Quick Action creates.

---

## Help Center: Schedules

URL: https://cloudofworship.com/docs/building-your-service/schedules

A schedule is the ordered set of slides for one service or event. Create one from a template or from blank, then switch, rename or delete.

A **schedule** is the ordered set of slides for one service or event.

## Creating a schedule

Click the **⌄** next to the schedule name in the top bar:

![Create a schedule dialog](/images/docs/01-schedule-picker.webp)

| Option | Use it when |
|--------|-------------|
| **Start from blank** | You'll build the running order yourself |
| **Regular Sunday** | Standard weekly service skeleton |
| **Communion Service** | Communion running order |
| **Christmas Schedule** | Seasonal template |
| **Recent Schedules** | Jump back into something you built before. **See all** shows the full list |

Each row shows when the schedule was last **updated**. A schedule that hasn't synced yet shows when it was made, or *just now*. Each row also shows its 6-character code, which you can give to someone who needs the [livestream](/docs/going-live/livestream-output-obs-vmix#the-schedule-code) or [stage display](/docs/going-live/stage-display) link.

Schedules are listed by when their slides last changed, so the one you worked on most recently comes first, even if the schedule itself wasn't re-saved.

## Share a schedule with a teammate

Click the **⋮** on a schedule row and choose **Copy link**. Paste the link to a teammate and it opens that schedule on their computer. If they aren't signed in yet, CoW takes them through sign in first and then opens it.

- A schedule that hasn't synced yet says *It opens on other computers once this schedule syncs*.
- If the link can't open, you'll see *Couldn't open that schedule*. The schedule may have been deleted, or it belongs to another church. Offline, CoW asks the teammate to connect to the internet.
- You can also paste a copied schedule link anywhere in CoW outside a text box, and the schedule opens.

## Switching, renaming and deleting

- **Switch:** open the dialog and click any schedule.
- **Rename:** click the schedule name in the top bar.
- **Per-schedule actions:** the **⋮** on each row.

::callout{type="important" title="Switching schedules clears the live projection"}
This is deliberate, so a slide from a previous service can't linger on screen. Promote a slide from the new schedule when ready.
::

::callout{type="tip"}
**Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + S** opens the schedules list from anywhere.
::

---

Bible, Song, Song Setlist, Hymn, Text, Media, Countdown, Interlude, Camera and Presentation slides, and which Quick Action creates each one.

|------|-------|-----------|
| **Bible** | Bible | Display Bible / Search Whole Bible / Transcribe Sermon |
| **Song** | Song | Search song lyrics / Add Song / My Library |
| **Song Setlist** | Setlist | Song Setlist |
| **Hymn** | Hymn | Display Hymns |
| **Text** | Text | Create Text Slide |
| **Media** | Media | Add Media / YouTube / Vimeo |
| **Countdown** | — | Add Countdown Timer |
| **Interlude** | Interlude | Add Interlude |
| **Camera** | Camera | Add Camera |
| **Presentation** | — | Import Slides from PDF |

## Overlays

Any slide can also be flagged as an **overlay** (via **⋮ → Duplicate as Overlay**), which layers it over the live slide rather than replacing it. See [Alerts & overlays](/docs/going-live/alerts-and-overlays).

## Help Center: Adding Scripture

URL: https://cloudofworship.com/docs/building-your-service/adding-scripture

Open any Bible reference with Display Bible, search the whole Bible by phrase, and step through verses with the arrow keys.

![Display Bible panel](/images/docs/04-display-bible.webp)

## Display a reference

1. Click **Display Bible**.
2. Type a reference into **Search scriptures**: `John 3:16`, `Matt 28:19`.
3. Select the verse. It's added to the schedule and opens in the editor.

Not opened any scripture yet? The panel offers an **Open Genesis 1** starting point.

## Search by phrase

Use **Search Whole Bible** when you remember a phrase but not the reference.

## Change the translation

Change the default translation in **Settings → Bible Version Settings**. You can also save translations for [offline use](/docs/settings-and-shortcuts/offline-use).

::callout{type="tip" title="Step through verses"}
With a Bible slide selected, **←** and **→** step through verses.
::

::callout{type="tip" title="Shorthand references work"}
In the verse switcher (in the slide editor), you can abbreviate the book and use spaces instead of a colon. Type `mat 28 19` and press Enter to jump straight to Matthew 28:19.
::

---

## Help Center: Adding Songs & Hymns

URL: https://cloudofworship.com/docs/building-your-service/adding-songs-and-hymns

Save your own songs to My Library, pull lyrics for any song, and find hymns by title or number.

## Adding a song

![Add a song](/images/docs/06-add-song.webp)

1. Click **Add Song**.
2. Fill in **Title** and **Artist**.
3. Paste the **Lyrics**.
4. Save. The song lands in [My Library](/docs/building-your-service/my-library), reusable in any future schedule.

::callout{type="tip" title="Break lyrics into verses"}
Add an **empty line** if you wish to forcefully break your lyrics into verses. Especially useful for building a worship lineup: each blank line starts a new slide.
::

There's also a **Share this song with other users?** option when saving.

## Searching song lyrics

Use **Search song lyrics** to pull lyrics for a song you haven't saved. Matching words are highlighted in the results, and hovering a result scrolls its preview to the line that best matches your search. When a song comes up because of a lyric line rather than its title, that line is shown under the song in place of the artist, so you can see why it matched.

*Teams feature, with 50 free songs a month on Free.* Searching and previewing is always free. On the Free plan, adding a song from the results to your schedule uses one of the month's **50 library songs**, and the panel shows how many are left. The count resets at midnight UTC on the 1st of each month. Teams has no limit.

## Adding a song fast

Click a song and a spinner shows until it lands in the schedule. Songs your church has used before are added instantly, even offline. Clicking twice no longer adds a song twice.

## Languages and translations

When you add or edit a song in **My Library**, open **Language & translations**:

1. Under **Sung in**, start typing the language the song is sung in.
2. Under **Translated into**, add up to **8** languages and type or paste the translation for each. Write one line for each sung line, in the same order. Blank lines and labels like *Chorus* are skipped.
3. Review the translations line by line before you save. CoW warns if a translated line has no sung line to go under, or a sung line has no translation yet (it will show without one).

If you paste lyrics that already have the English in brackets after each line, CoW offers to move it into an English translation for you during the review. It leaves brackets alone when the song is sung in English.

To show a translation on screen, select the song slide and click **Show translation** in the toolbar. It is on by default when the song has one. The translation sits under each lyric line. Opening a song slide picks up lyric and translation fixes without pressing Refresh. If a translation is wrong, use **Report an issue** in the editor, see [Editing a slide](/docs/building-your-service/editing-a-slide#report-an-issue).

## Hymns

Click **Display Hymns** and search by **title or hymn number**. No match shows *"We couldn't find that hymn"*. Try the number or a distinctive lyric.

## Running several songs together

For a back-to-back worship medley, group songs in a [Song Setlist](/docs/building-your-service/song-setlists) instead of separate slides.

---

## Help Center: Text Slides

URL: https://cloudofworship.com/docs/building-your-service/text-slides

Make announcement, welcome and sermon-point slides with Create Text Slide: fonts, sizes, colours, lists, quotes and alignment.

Text slides are for anything that isn't a song, a hymn or a Bible verse: announcements, a welcome message, sermon points, giving details, event dates or a prayer focus. They're free on every plan.

![Rich text editor](/images/docs/09-create-text-slide.webp)

## Create a text slide

1. In the [Quick Actions Pane](/docs/control-center/quick-actions-pane), click **Create Text Slide** (or press **Cmd/Ctrl + K** and search for it).
2. The slide is added to your schedule and opens in the [Preview and Edit Content Pane](/docs/control-center/preview-and-edit-pane).
3. Type your text straight onto the slide. Changes save as you go.

## The text toolbar

When a text slide is selected, the toolbar above it shows:

| Control | What it does |
|---------|--------------|
| **Font size** (− / +) | Steps the text size up or down, shown as a percentage |
| **Bold**, **Italic**, **Strikethrough** | Emphasis for a word or line |
| **Normal text** | Turns a heading back into body text |
| **Bullet list**, **Numbered list** | Sermon points, steps or a list of events |
| **Align left / centre / right** | Line up the selected text |
| **Font** | Pick a typeface for the selection |
| **Text colour** | Recolour words, for example to highlight a key phrase |
| **Quote** | Set off a quotation |
| **Code block** | Monospaced text, handy for Wi-Fi details or a giving reference |

## Keyboard shortcuts in the editor

| Shortcut | Action |
|----------|--------|
| **Cmd/Ctrl + B** / **I** | Bold / italic |
| **Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + X** | Strikethrough |
| **Cmd/Ctrl + Alt + 1 / 2 / 3** | Heading 1, 2 or 3 |
| **Cmd/Ctrl + Alt + 0** | Normal text |
| **Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + 8** / **7** | Bullet list / numbered list |
| **Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + L / E / R** | Align left / centre / right |
| **Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + B** | Quote |
| **Cmd/Ctrl + Alt + C** | Code block |
| **Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + >** / **<** | Increase / decrease font size |

The full list is on the [Keyboard shortcuts](/docs/settings-and-shortcuts/keyboard-shortcuts) page.

## Make it readable from the back row

- Keep each slide to one idea. Several short slides read better than one crowded one.
- Use a heading for the main point and normal text for the detail.
- Put the slide on a calm [background](/docs/building-your-service/slide-backgrounds), and lower the background's **Brightness** if the text gets lost.

## Show a text slide on top of another slide

A text slide using the full-text or heading-and-subtitle layout can be turned into an overlay with **⋮ → Duplicate as Overlay**, so it sits over whatever is live instead of replacing it. See [Alerts & overlays](/docs/going-live/alerts-and-overlays#overlays-teams).

::callout{type="tip" title="Reuse it every week"}
Announcements that repeat, such as the welcome or giving slide, can be saved to [My Library](/docs/building-your-service/my-library) so you don't retype them for every schedule.
::

---

## Help Center: Adding Media

URL: https://cloudofworship.com/docs/building-your-service/adding-media

Display images, video or audio from your files, or embed a YouTube or Vimeo video.

![Media picker](/images/docs/10-add-media.webp)

**Add Media** has two tabs:

- **Files**: drag and drop, paste from your file explorer, or click to browse images, video and audio.
- **YouTube/Vimeo**: paste a video URL to embed. YouTube and Vimeo embeds are a **Teams** feature.

::callout{type="warning" title="Add media ahead of the service"}
Media is stored locally first and uploaded in the background. Adding a large video right before it's needed is risky. Add media ahead of the service where you can.
::

## Upload limits

Limits depend on your plan. See [Slide backgrounds](/docs/building-your-service/slide-backgrounds#upload-limits-depend-on-your-plan) and [Plans: Free vs Teams](/docs/teams-and-collaboration/plans-free-vs-teams).

## Media shortcuts

While a media slide is selected, **M** mutes or unmutes it and **Space** plays or pauses it.

---

## Help Center: Countdown Timers

URL: https://cloudofworship.com/docs/building-your-service/countdown-timers

Create a countdown slide for the congregation or run a private countdown on the stage display. A Teams feature.

*Teams feature.* On the Free plan the form still opens so you can try it, and the upgrade prompt appears when you create or start the countdown.

Quick Actions has two countdown destinations. Use **Live Display** when the congregation should see the timer, or **Stage Display** when only the band and speaker need it.

## Countdown slide for the congregation

1. Open **Add Countdown Timer** in Quick Actions and choose **Live Display**.
2. Pick a **Countdown duration**, or set the minutes and seconds precisely.
3. Optionally add text above the countdown.
4. Click **Create countdown slide**. The slide is added to the schedule, ready to take live.

When that slide is live, the Stage Display mirrors its remaining time unless a private stage countdown is active.

## Private countdown for the stage

1. On the computer running the Stage Display, search Quick Actions for **Stage Display Countdown**. This opens the same form on its **Stage Display** tab.
2. Set the duration and, if useful, add text beneath the countdown.
3. Click **Start stage countdown**. The timer starts on the Stage Display only. It does not create a slide or change the live output.

For a faster start, type *5 min countdown* into Quick Actions and select **Start 5 minutes countdown on stage display**. The same search also offers a live countdown action, so check the destination before selecting one.

The Stage Display has start, pause and reset buttons for its private countdown. Search **Clear Stage Countdown** when you want the service stopwatch back. If the stopwatch was running, it keeps its elapsed time underneath the countdown. See [Stage Display](/docs/going-live/stage-display) for the panel's display order and controls.

Stage clock commands work from the presentation computer. The phone's Quick Actions can still create a countdown slide for the live output, but they do not control the Stage Display clock.

::callout{type="tip"}
Need the current time instead? **Add Time Slide** displays the time of day. Like countdowns, it is a Teams feature.
::

---

## Help Center: Interlude Slides

URL: https://cloudofworship.com/docs/building-your-service/interlude-slides

An animated break screen with a heading and sub text, for welcomes, offering, announcements and pauses in the service. A Teams feature.

*Teams feature.* On the Free plan you can open the panel and try every animation. The upgrade prompt appears when you create the slide.

An interlude is an animated slide for the moments between segments: before service starts, during the offering, over announcements or while the band resets. A heading and a line of sub text stay on screen while the animation loops behind them.

## Create an interlude slide

1. Open **Add Interlude** in Quick Actions. Searching *break*, *welcome*, *fellowship* or *we'll be right back* finds it too.
2. Type a **Heading** (up to 60 characters) and, optionally, a **Sub text** (up to 70 characters). New interludes start with *Welcome Home* and *We'll begin shortly*.
3. Choose an **Animation**. Hover over a card to see it move.
4. Once you've picked one, **Create interlude slide** appears at the bottom. Click it and the slide is added to the schedule, ready to take live.

When you move from an interlude to the next slide, its text fades out before the next slide appears, so the change never feels abrupt.

## Animations

| Animation | Works well for |
|-----------|----------------|
| **CoW Original** | Communion, prayer, any service break |
| **Selah** | Countdowns to service, a pause between segments |
| **Still Waters** | Worship set intros, offering, reflection |
| **Lilies** | Easter, Mother's Day, women's fellowship |
| **Jubilee** | Celebration Sundays, youth nights, thanksgiving |
| **Gathering** | Welcome loops, pre-service, series titles |
| **Open Heavens** | Service start, conferences, youth |
| **Fellowship** | Announcements, events, fellowship breaks |
| **Rolling Stone** | Series titles, welcome, conference breaks |

The heading in **Rolling Stone** rolls across the screen in big purple type, row after row. **CoW Original** is the default. Each animation comes with its own colours, so there is no separate background to pick.

## Text background

**Text background** controls the panel behind the heading and sub text:

- **Animation default** lets each animation decide.
- **Always on** keeps the text readable on busy animations or bright projectors.
- **Off** shows the text straight on the animation.

## Changing an interlude later

Select the slide in the schedule and open the **Interlude** tab in the Preview & Edit Pane. **Animation** switches the animation straight away. **Texts** lets you edit the heading, sub text and text background, then save. Interlude slides paint their own background, so the usual **Background** tab is not shown for them.

::callout{type="tip"}
An interlude is different from [Blank](/docs/going-live/blank-screen). Blank clears the Live Display for a moment and is always one key away. An interlude is a slide in your schedule with a message on it.
::

---

## Help Center: Camera Slides

URL: https://cloudofworship.com/docs/building-your-service/camera-slides

Show a webcam or capture card full screen on the Live Output, for the preacher, a stage shot or a baptism.

A camera slide puts a live picture from a webcam or capture card on the Live Output, full screen. Use it for a close-up of the preacher, a shot of the baptism pool or a camera feed from the back of the room.

::callout{type="note" title="Rolling out gradually"}
Camera slides are being switched on for churches in stages. If **Add Camera** is missing from Quick Actions, it hasn't reached your church yet.
::

## Add a camera slide

1. Open **Add Camera** in Quick Actions. Searching *webcam*, *capture card* or *preacher* finds it too.
2. Allow camera access when your browser asks. If you refuse, the form says **Camera access denied** and explains how to allow it again in your browser's site settings.
3. Pick a camera from the list. Click **Refresh** if you plugged one in after opening the form. A preview shows the picture.
4. Choose how it fills the screen:
   - **Fill (crops the edges)** covers the whole screen.
   - **Fit (shows the whole picture)** keeps the full picture with bars if the shapes differ.
5. Turn on **Flip horizontally (mirror effect)** if the picture looks backwards.
6. Click **Add to schedule**.

To change any of this later, select the slide and open **Camera settings** in the Preview & Edit Pane.

## Where the camera opens

The camera only opens in the live window (and in NDI output) and in your Live Output preview. Schedule thumbnails, the editor, the livestream page, the Stage Display and the phone screen show a **Camera is live** card instead. They never open a camera, so nothing else on your network can grab it.

- CoW opens the camera at 1080p, capped at 30 frames per second.
- Going from a camera slide to lyrics and back to the camera reuses the open camera, so there is no delay.
- While a camera slide is live, the preview in the editor says **Preview paused**.
- If the slide's camera isn't plugged into this computer, the form shows it as **Not connected to this computer**. The projector falls back to another camera instead of showing black.

::callout{type="warning" title="Safari and the macOS app"}
Safari's engine lets only one page hold a camera at a time. If the preview and the projector compete, the projector takes priority.
::

To show a camera beside your lyrics or scripture, see [Slide pairs](/docs/building-your-service/slide-pairs).

---

## Help Center: Slide Pairs

URL: https://cloudofworship.com/docs/building-your-service/slide-pairs

Show a camera together with another slide on the Live Output: beside it, over it or as a caption. A Teams feature.

*Teams feature.* A slide pair puts **two slides on the Live Output at once**. Every pair includes a [camera slide](/docs/building-your-service/camera-slides), so you can show the speaker next to the scripture, or the choir next to the lyrics.

::callout{type="note" title="Rolling out gradually"}
Slide pairs depend on camera slides, which are being switched on in stages. If you don't see **Add Camera**, you won't see pairing either.
::

## Make a pair

1. Add a camera slide to the schedule.
2. Search Quick Actions for **Create Slide Pair**, or open the camera slide's **⋯** menu and choose **Start a pair**. Quick Actions starts from the selected camera, or the first unpaired camera in the schedule. With no camera yet, it asks you to add one first and opens **Add Camera**.
3. Pick the other slide from the list. Use **Search slides** to find it.

Alternatively, drag a slide onto a camera slide in the schedule. Only camera slides accept a drop. A pair can be a camera and one other slide, or two cameras. A slide can only be in one pair at a time.

To swap the partner later, use **Change paired slide** in the camera's **⋯** menu. To split them, choose **Unpair Slides**.

## Choose a layout

Select either slide in the pair and open **Pair settings** in the Preview & Edit Pane. It has two sections: **Layout**, and **Pair background**, which sets the background behind the pair. The camera always takes the picture's place in the layout, whatever the other slide is. With two cameras, the first in the pair does.

| Layout | What the congregation sees |
|--------|----------------------------|
| **Side by side** | The camera in a card beside the other slide, on the pair background |
| **Picture in picture** | The other slide full screen, the camera in a small card |
| **Caption** | The camera full screen, the other slide across the bottom |
| **Lower third** | The camera full screen, the other slide in a box across the bottom |

## Running a pair

- **Advancing:** Up and Down, media controls and the Stage Display follow the non-camera slide. With two cameras, they follow the first in the pair.
- **Editing:** Pair settings shows which slide you're editing. Switching it only changes your own window. It never changes what the projector shows.
- **Hide one:** the eye button beside a slide in the editor toolbar hides it (*Hide from screen; the other slide fills it*) and brings it back (*Show on screen*). You can still change the layout while one is hidden. It applies once the slide is shown again.
- **Swap the cameras:** in a pair of two cameras, this button in Pair settings flips which camera takes the picture's place.
- **Sound:** a camera's microphone is never played through the projector automatically, so the sound system can't feed back.

::callout{type="important" title="If your plan lapses"}
A pair is a Teams feature. If your church loses Teams, the pair stays in the schedule but can't be taken live until Teams returns.
::

---

## Help Center: Importing Slides from a PDF

URL: https://cloudofworship.com/docs/building-your-service/importing-slides-from-pdf

Turn a PDF from Canva, PowerPoint or Google Slides, such as a sermon deck or printed programme, into a presentation slide you can page through live.

Already have a sermon deck, an order of service or a set of announcements designed somewhere else? **Import Slides from PDF** brings it into Cloud of Worship (CoW) as a **presentation slide**, with every page of the PDF ready to show. It's free on every plan.

## Export your deck as a PDF first

CoW imports PDFs from any app. Export or download your deck as a PDF from:

- **PowerPoint**: File → Export → PDF (or Save As → PDF).
- **Google Slides**: File → Download → PDF document.
- **Canva**: Share → Download → PDF Standard.
- **Keynote**: File → Export To → PDF.

## Import the PDF

1. In the [Quick Actions Pane](/docs/control-center/quick-actions-pane), click **Import Slides from PDF** (or press **Cmd/Ctrl + K** and search for it).
2. Drag your PDF onto **Upload a File or Drag & Drop here**, or click to browse. The maximum file size is **50 MB**.
3. Click **Create slides**. CoW reads the PDF, renders each page, and adds a single presentation slide to your schedule holding all the pages.

Pages are converted to JPEG images of up to 1920 pixels across, so even large, photo-heavy pages upload quickly. If a page still fails to upload, CoW keeps it on your device and retries. See [Some pages didn't upload](/docs/troubleshooting/media-and-transcription-problems#some-pages-didnt-upload).

## Present the pages

Select the presentation slide and put it on screen like any other slide (see [Promoting slides](/docs/going-live/promoting-slides)). Then move through the pages:

- Press **→** for the next page and **←** for the previous one.
- Or use the **Previous page** and **Next page** buttons in the editor, which also show the current page number (for example *3 / 12*).
- Or click a page thumbnail to jump straight to it.

## Recent Slides

::callout{type="tip" title="Open it again"}
CoW remembers decks you've already imported **on this device** under **Recent Slides**, so you can reuse a deck for a repeating series without uploading it again. This list is local to the device you imported on, not synced to your church workspace.
::

## Tips for decks that look good on a projector

- Design at **16:9** so the pages fill the screen without black bars.
- Use large text. A page that reads well on a laptop can be hard to read from the back of the hall.
- Animations and videos inside the deck don't carry over to a PDF. Add videos separately with [Add Media](/docs/building-your-service/adding-media).
- For text you'll want to change week to week, a [text slide](/docs/building-your-service/text-slides) is easier to edit than a re-imported PDF.

---

## Help Center: Editing a Slide

URL: https://cloudofworship.com/docs/building-your-service/editing-a-slide

Change the font, size, lines per slide and background of a single slide, even while it's live.

Select a slide in the Preview and Edit Content Pane:

![Slide editor](/images/docs/03-slide-editor.webp)

| Control | What it does |
|---------|--------------|
| **Slide title and type badge** | Confirms what you're editing (for example "Hymn 61 · Hymn") |
| **◀ Verse ▶** | Step through verses or stanzas |
| **Font dropdown** | Typeface for this slide |
| **− 90 +** | Font size percentage |
| **Lines** | Lines of content per slide |
| **Fit each line on one row** | Song, setlist and hymn slides only. Shrinks the words just enough that no line wraps, instead of shrinking the whole verse to fit |
| **Show translation** | Song slides with a translation only. Shows it under each lyric line |
| **Background** | Opens the background panel. See [Slide backgrounds](/docs/building-your-service/slide-backgrounds) |
| **Go Live** | Promote this exact slide immediately |

Style changes here apply to **this slide only**. To change how *future* slides look, use **Settings → Slide Settings**.

::callout{type="important" title="You can edit a slide while it is live"}
Changes appear on the Live Display as you make them.
::

## Report an issue

Spot a wrong lyric, verse or slide? Click the faint warning button in the corner of the slide preview. Pick what's wrong, then describe what you noticed under **What did you notice?** and send it. The choices depend on the slide: songs offer *Lyrics are wrong*, *Translation is wrong* and *Title or artist is wrong*; hymns offer *Words are wrong* and *Wrong hymn number or title*; scripture offers *Verse text is wrong* and *Wrong reference*. Every slide also has *Something else*. It goes straight to the CoW team with the song, hymn or verse attached, so you don't have to explain which one.

## Styling shortcuts

While a slide is selected:

| Shortcut | Action |
|----------|--------|
| **Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + >** | Increase font size |
| **Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + <** | Decrease font size |
| **Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + U** | Uppercase the slide text |
| **Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + K** | Toggle the line background behind the text |

The full list is in [Keyboard shortcuts](/docs/settings-and-shortcuts/keyboard-shortcuts).

---

## Help Center: Slide Backgrounds

URL: https://cloudofworship.com/docs/building-your-service/slide-backgrounds

Add an image, video, colour or gradient behind a slide, tune blur and brightness, and pick how media fills the screen.

Click **Background** in the slide editor. Five sections:

| Section | What it does |
|---------|--------------|
| **Add Image** | Upload or drag and drop a background image |
| **Add Video** | Upload or drag and drop a background video |
| **Add Colour** | Solid colour |
| **Add Gradient** | Gradient presets |
| **Background style** | **Blur** and **Brightness** sliders, plus how the media fills the slide |

**Fill types:** Fit · Stretch · Crop · Crop (Top) · Crop (Bottom)

## Upload limits depend on your plan

| | Free | Teams |
|---|------|-------|
| Background image | 3 MB | 10 MB |
| Background video | 250 MB | No limit |

::callout{type="tip" title="Keep lyrics readable"}
Use the **Brightness** slider to darken a busy photo so lyrics stay readable, rather than hunting for a darker image.
::

## Default backgrounds

You can set **default backgrounds per slide type** (Bible, hymn, text) in **Settings → Slide Background Settings**.

## Related guides

- [Editing a slide](/docs/building-your-service/editing-a-slide): change the font, size and lines per slide.
- [Adding media](/docs/building-your-service/adding-media): put a full-screen image or video on its own slide.
- [Settings reference](/docs/settings-and-shortcuts/settings-reference): default backgrounds and the blank-screen background.
- [Plans: Free vs Teams](/docs/teams-and-collaboration/plans-free-vs-teams): upload limits on each plan.
